stories.title: g1 realiza debate com candidatos do CE ao Senado nesta segunda (21): veja quem participa, horário, regras e como assistir

en.title: g1 holds debate with candidates for Senate in CE this Monday (21): see who participates, schedule, rules and how to watch
en.summary: G1 is hosting a debate on Monday featuring candidates for Ceará's Senate seat, moderated by William Santos and broadcast from Fortaleza across multiple platforms at 2 p.m. The event is part of Globo's coverage of the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Ônibus de romeiros que caiu em ribanceira e matou seis pessoas: veja o que se sabe sobre acidente em Cruzeiro, SP

en.title: Bus carrying pilgrims that fell into ravine and killed six people: see what is known about accident in Cruzeiro, SP
en.summary: A bus transporting pilgrims from Minas Gerais to Aparecida fell approximately 15 meters into a ravine in Cruzeiro, São Paulo early Sunday, killing six people including a child and injuring dozens. The vehicle was carrying 48 passengers.

en.title: Paraná increases investments and reduces cash at end of Ratinho Junior's second term
en.summary: Governor Ratinho Junior completes his second term in Paraná with positive fiscal results, though lower than those achieved during his first four years in office.

en.title: Chad Gilbert, guitarist of New Found Glory, dies at 45 years old
en.summary: Chad Gilbert, guitarist and co-founder of the band New Found Glory, died in his sleep at age 45. The death was announced by the band and his wife, singer Lisa Cimorelli, on Instagram.

en.summary: Brazilian President Lula has scheduled meetings in New York with U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, and Uruguayan President Yamandú Orsi on Monday.

en.title: See how the weekend was for presidential candidates

en.summary: The law office of Alexandre de Moraes' wife stated that private jet travel arrangements for firm employees involve no personal ties, following a report showing the Supreme Court justice and his wife disembarking in Rio de Janeiro in August 2025.

en.summary: A bus carrying pilgrims fell down an embankment in São Paulo state, resulting in six deaths. The driver was taken into custody.

en.title: Yen rebounds after 2% decline and market monitors next steps from BoJ
en.summary: Currency markets focused on the yen following its sharp weekly decline, which sparked speculation about potential changes to Japan's interest rate trajectory. Investors assessed rate expectations amid recent increases from major central banks.

stories.title: Microsseguros escalam e atuam como motor de inclusão financeira

en.title: Microinsurance scales up and acts as a driver of financial inclusion
en.summary: Personal insurance contracting in Brazil increased by 10% in the first half of the year, with products like life insurance and accident coverage reaching R$ 41.6 billion, while claims payments grew 7.9% to R$ 8.9 billion.

en.title: Presença Group debuts in the asset leverage market
en.summary: Grupo Presença launched Presença Invest to operate in the consortia segment, offering credit opportunities across contemplated letters, working capital, and canceled letters to expand access to asset acquisition and wealth planning alternatives.

en.title: Lula arrives in NY for UN Assembly and will have a brief stay due to election
en.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva arrived in New York to attend the 81st United Nations General Assembly, greeting supporters upon arrival but declining to speak with the press.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula pede cassação do registro da chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro por uso irregular do Instagram

en.title: Lula's campaign requests cancellation of Flávio Bolsonaro's slate registration for irregular Instagram use
en.summary: A coalition led by PT filed an electoral investigation lawsuit against Flávio Bolsonaro and allies, accusing them of benefiting from Instagram support pages used to amplify campaign propaganda through collaborative posts.
